## How you checked it

- [ ] `npm run build` passes (types and build)
- [ ] The `verify:` scripts for the parts you touched pass (CI runs them all)
- [ ] Changed anything under `core/`? `npm run verify` passes on your own Mac
- [ ] Changed what the window shows? A screenshot or short recording is below

## Before you send it

- [ ] Comments say why, not what, like the code around them
- [ ] Nothing writes to another tool's sessions or transcripts (README, Principles)
- [ ] No new dependency, or the PR says what it costs and what it saves
- [ ] Took code or ideas from another project? `CREDITS.md` says so
